items.question: What is the fee for obtaining the Unmanned Aircraft Operator Authorisation (UOA) for drone operators in the UAE?
items.fact: UOA fee for organisation drone operators is AED 1,200

items.question: What is the minimum age to fly a drone weighing more than 25 kg under UAE GCAA drone rules?
items.fact: Minimum age to fly drones over 25 kg is 21
